text: Assessment: valid current source defect, now repaired in working tree. Dense and fixed-effects point consumers read optional statuses directly; full materialization API remains. Public allocation regression failed before (5,042,176 bytes / 256 lookups / 4096 voxels) and passed after (32,768 bytes, 99.35% lower). Shared JVM/JS behavior tests preserve IDs, default/explicit statuses, exclusions, malformed lengths and variance refinement. Broader tests exposed stale mixed-TR SPMG fixtures; regenerated from corrected R source with exact source-file lock and independent nuisance contrast oracle. All 89 affected Scala tests passed (45 JVM including allocation, 44 JS), 2 Python receipt-integrity tests and finalizer --check passed. No wall-clock gate; byte measurement JVM-only, portable allocation bound established by removing both per-point materializations. Evidence: docs/audits/voxel-status-allocation.md. Uncommitted; active PHRF edits preserved.
